notes.title: WorldBox Update — 0.50: Monolith Awakens. Open Steam Beta Starts April 1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/7bf1c7a5f4216bc547728a7e6741fa094b3c5b56.png[/img]

We are excited to announce that the open beta starts [strike]Monolith[/strike] April First! 🎉
Yes, this is really happening!

Weeee!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/d260a8cc7476340e2779e983028fcfd42e798198.gif[/img]

On this day, the [b]Monoliths [/b]will awaken with their [i]first [/i]power — rewriting the very fabric of life around them. 

They can alter genes and species traits, sometimes granting consciousness where there was none, allowing new civilizations to emerge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/8b26d026de6411d4adcabf569e5a4158a40fe8f8.png[/img]
In some cases, the Monoliths' power may trigger unexpected mutations. 🌀🧬

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/84a14389040eeddd03852ff1bd65d7cd1fa4ae78.png[/img]
Each sapient species has their own unique set of clan🩸, culture🍵, language💬, and religion🔥 traits, which you can adjust and combine.

Some species don’t mind sharing a city with others. Some, however, are fiercely territorial.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img]

Many new civilizations have been added - without spoiling too much, here’s a sneak peek:

🐸 Ribbits ribbitting
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/20c94b35a18057e2b01ebfd86485bd238a3ae4fb.png[/img]

🐧 Coolbeaks chilling in the permafrost biome
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/edca1826da9993e68f705e1082eaf890e84fe803.png[/img]

🍀 Druids think they’re being clover
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/90701d3cf08156cd838469983ce6c8a5738344e3.png[/img]

And remember, you can modify any subspecies with traits like hovering in the air, budding reproduction, or even create elves that eat wood for breakfast. 🌿🍽️

So… what [strike]horrible[/strike] beautiful creatures will [i]you [/i]create? ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/f6460ac1f35450ab85f197f7a9d5dd90d9d7ae44.png[/img]
All features from past announcements are tied to an [b]improved AI system[/b] that works closely with meta-objects, making units feel a bit more alive than before! 🧠✨

[h1][b]How does it work?[/b][/h1]
Unit traits🤳, statuses⁉️, subspecies🧬, clans🩸, cultures🍵, languages💬, and religions🔥 — even [b]items[/b] ([i]technically, for now... we still need to add content for that later[/i]) - all influence [b]behavior[/b] by adding neurons to a unit’s [b]decision-making process[/b].

🔬 This Brain Screen lets you observe the minds of your creatures and also lets you [strike]be a horrible person[/strike] silence specific neurons 😈

([i]Like preventing a king from eating so he slowly starves... not that you’d ever do that, right?[/i])
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/f7b514a3e6c131f087e17f580e0cf5e4629a0416.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img]

The [b]new Brain AI[/b] also integrates with the happiness system.

Units now [b]react [/b]to what happens to them. If things don't go their way, they might [b]get sad[/b] 😢 or[b] angry[/b] 😡 or even throw tantrums.

And when their family dies... well, they might just break down in tears. 💔

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/f17679dcf0f7ea7360d0ba8babe38c49e66a04ff.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img]

📜 [b]World Ages[/b] can now be arranged like seasons, letting you control the flow of time and chaos in your world!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/3190c4804522e4718446481e97232e244cbeb64b.png[/img]

🔍 [b]Items got an upgrade[/b]! You can favorite them and track who's holding onto them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/503057d966ea20fcc651747951fc4b2b0dd112c9.png[/img]

🌧️ [b]Loot rain[/b]! You can now shower your creatures with [b]more of your beloved sticks[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/44000a001ab551a9129169b40711fd0d4b8905d3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img]

[h1]The Art of Naming[/h1]
With so many new species, we needed a lot of name generators.
So, we made [b]a game out of it[/b]!

Cultures now have a new tab called "[b]Onomastics[/b]", which controls naming templates for [b]units, families (last names), clans, and cities[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/c0ed9a5d2029336c613e906cc58bd850a0192d79.png[/img]
It might look a little scary at first, but don’t worry — it should all make sense (we hope) as you play around with it during beta! 👀🔠

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/32cefbaa6d58edf8e15a8cbaf43d9762e0d3cd53.png[/img]
⚡ Paradox Biome: Where two years fly by faster than you can blink!

There’s still more to show - including one big, double-fun feature that will be revealed when the Monolith awakens!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2b850c6cbb34a377390b247183dd54f84b63f979.png[/img]

[h2]Mobile Version Update[/h2]
📱 We'll also be testing the mobile version in a closed beta alongside the PC open beta. Due to platform restrictions, we can't offer an open beta for mobile. And we need to thoroughly test everything before the official release.

Stay tuned for more information on the mobile version in April. We appreciate your patience as we work to ensure the best possible experience across all platforms. 🚀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/e0850bc07f14c3a6d5aa1d74d0f54d10f0f6598c.gif[/img]

The next update will introduce [b]Religions[/b]🔥, another new meta-object that you can observe, influence and modify!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/c62f24c700d31e30b353fb397b4d2139504c2ef9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/f2d7176ad04936afd8d435829e0d1ac54b973daf.png[/img]

Much like Cultures and Languages, [b]Religions[/b]🔥will spread through conversations, books, and a few... other [i]unusual means[/i] 😴🌀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/52a4493cba5499a9eb4f3702079a2d7f37cf821c.png[/img]

Most species can develop their [b]own religion[/b]🔥- if they have the Advanced [b]Hippocampus [/b]trait (a subspecies trait).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/47061e1c47fd0ac355b096ed4ccc31356126eb18.png[/img]

But faith isn’t just about belief - it grants [b]real power[/b]. Religions🔥 provide followers with passive traits, spells, and mystical rites (as new plots) 🧙

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/77e30fbe43516f850ef22752e8ff63061fd554dc.png[/img]

Depending on the species and biome where a [b]religion[/b]🔥 emerges, some can unlock devastating magic for their followers. Imagine a mighty king calling down meteor showers upon his enemies. All because he dared to read an ancient demon book and [i]reading is [b]power[/b][/i] 🤓

But great power always comes at a cost 🤦

Some rituals can bring disaster to the world itself 🏜️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/f28db85c4525b96b3e98f0f1b00f78db163314d0.gif[/img]

Usually, only those of divine blood - the rulers and chosen few - are allowed to use such magic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/4ae57893b7d512a7aaaeddb203edc7dccb22abfe.png[/img]

And if you want to teach a king and his heirs a lesson⚡, you can always take back the power [i]that was yours to begin with[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/08a1643f52dc2a263a23d07bfdada4373fd0a7a9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/e8e6f6f2bc8d5d7990ee04acd99ffdd032651655.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/87e2a96699e574d348f361101ad3b2a177c2251f.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/1abf732b543da673fb585015bd9920ddfefc0ece.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/7f7ab7cc34b8f1aa343c728dd2191000b4d2d998.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/1abf732b543da673fb585015bd9920ddfefc0ece.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/87e2a96699e574d348f361101ad3b2a177c2251f.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/e8e6f6f2bc8d5d7990ee04acd99ffdd032651655.png[/img]

[b]Religions[/b]🔥 aren’t the only way magic manifests in the world. Some species are born magical by their very nature - and you can influence🧬 that too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/59d95f210c1469a281c4b472f8bcd9f5ebe8cce3.gif[/img]

Ever wanted to create a GMO🧬 [b]turtle species[/b] that can control wind, summon fire, multiply like rabbits, and live for thousands of years? 🦗🦗🦗 No? Well, you will be able to 🔥🐢

notes.title: SneakBox: Languages, books, small talk and learning
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/12c77be0915ac5e2e598971b1e286ac96f2a7f54.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/8c8b1c85a35b71ccaae2ddc80ca3806ead48443a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/89418bd69447a8d601317c0d35b6e511fc9a7728.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/8c8b1c85a35b71ccaae2ddc80ca3806ead48443a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/12c77be0915ac5e2e598971b1e286ac96f2a7f54.png[/img]

In the next update, we’re adding Languages💬 as the third/4 new type of "meta-object" in the game. They’ll become a key part of unit progression and the growth of civilizations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/007c587dce2ff194596a3a0cbc6a97112075ab28.png[/img]

Much like cultures, languages 💬 will influence opinions, loyalty, and now, [b]learning[/b].

Previously, units gained random attributes - such as Warfare⚔️, Diplomacy🕊️, Intelligence🧠, or Stewardship📝 - simply by aging. With this update, clan members can write books, and others can read them (if they know the language or possess a specific trait).

Books will grant experience to readers, making it possible for non-warrior characters to level up(level cap is increased a bit btw) without combat. They can also influence mood and happiness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/e22a5582f11fb2c7e01314fb6fbd8f226aa58be3.png[/img]

Similar to biological traits passed through birth, certain traits can now be shared through books and small talks, adding yet another layer to the civ-simulation.

Languages💬 and cultures won’t just belong to one species - they can cross borders. Even if a civilization is wiped out, their legacy can survive through their books.

And just like cultures and subspecies, languages can be customized using the Language Trait Editor.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/1f0ddfce272317ceaad85d73db952d6b816285ca.png[/img]

[b]Imagine this:[/b]

An ancient demon kingdom lies in ruins, but their language 💬 and culture endure in dusty tomes scattered across the land. If an ordinary mortal dares to read one of these hellish books, they might melt under its sheer power - unless, of course, they’re fireproof 🧑‍🚒 (or have a drink nearby).

But if someone succeeds? They could revive the demon culture, bringing it into their city. What would happen next? Who knows? [b]Idk?[/b] 🎃

notes.title: Families, Genealogy, Graphs
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/a9ba488ad19291812476b14499c0ce8ee62094c4.png[/img]

Happy holidays, everyone! We hope you're all enjoying and will continue to enjoy great times with your families.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/7687dd88eddb6d5a2fc813768b36088009bc6cd6.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/7687dd88eddb6d5a2fc813768b36088009bc6cd6.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/7687dd88eddb6d5a2fc813768b36088009bc6cd6.png[/img]

Speaking of families, in our next update, we are adding a family system. 
Family ties will affect relationships between characters.

To give you a brief overview, here are some screenshots(work in progress):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/ef699946fe04a6a2c5655461dc13c4ef3e0992bd.png[/img]
To represent families and their banners, we ended up using picture frames, which you can also customize and change colors. As usual you can also change family name

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/bc69c4f45a974b7ff907214b28d5b58a5e27ed8f.png[/img]
From the family screen, you can see which family members are currently alive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/e84e2dd5f610807deb6e048c8fefe6b5a099039f.png[/img]
You can explore family history and see the ancestral lines associated with it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/40b1a62e9f4872d80992e7605e50566f920c9dbb.png[/img]
And in unit window you will be able to to view generation and the genealogy of your people and animals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/e210d71005ee757110f9909b03c2936d48b406d5.png[/img]
In the subspecies menu, you'll be able to see which families exist in the world that are related to them. Similarly, this applies to the kingdom/city view.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/063828be2add36d0fff784a36b674a1c92cb7509.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/cb87f4317ae431d98221bac45b38029ed973a949.png[/img]
You'll also be able to view stat graphs showing how your people lived with the new Graphs tab. This feature works for every meta object: wars, alliances, kingdoms, cities, cultures, families, clans, subspecies and more!

We also have much more to show, including the main biggest feature! 

Next year will be huge for WorldBox! And we finally will have most of the big mechanics that tie all simulation parts together!

Thank you, everyone, for playing WorldBox and your continued support(and patience!) !

In this update, we're introducing species and subspecies as one of the new mechanics.

Whenever a new creature is created, it will be assigned to a subspecies.

Like other meta objects (such as cultures, kingdoms, wars), these can be viewed on the minimap. And you will be able to access their information and customize them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/b5720e842fc088d913f65a15a4d49f1dcb17519a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/e3691ef572ce4a1e60971c825f28ecbae47478c9.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/e3691ef572ce4a1e60971c825f28ecbae47478c9.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/e3691ef572ce4a1e60971c825f28ecbae47478c9.png[/img]

[strike]Subspecies will level up as more units of that subspecies are born. With each level-up, they will acquire genetic-body-related traits based on their population. These traits will have a high chance of being passed on to new offspring.[/strike]

Additionally, the likelihood of traits being influenced by biome-specific food will increase.

As a result, biomes could play a significant role in the simulation of evolution of your species in the world. 

The general UI design has also been refined, though it's still a work in progress.

New subspecies window:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/d2d8089587d855a07ee3f57d6d5452ce1c94a7bf.png[/img]

More big news is on the way! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/e3691ef572ce4a1e60971c825f28ecbae47478c9.png[/img]

We are proud to announce the long-awaited release of MEGABOX! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/d8a0938250bf536d4bc6a862bfb8a072d4c80e57.png[/img]

This patch has been many months in the making and combines multiple systems and 7 updates into one.

It adds:
- Ages - seasons that last for many years and bring disasters or prosperity to the world. From nightfall to madness, there’s many surprises included
- Alliances - they improves diplomacy by making civilizations unit together against common foes
- New Wars - wars now are more detailed. And you will be able to track how long it has been going on, including the death toll, etc
- Clans - kingdoms can and will be ruled by bloodlines and families. 
- Plans and Plots - addition to diplomacy, for making it more transparent who’s plotting what
- Music - we added new sound engine. Together with music based on what you’re watching right now and many new sounds!

notes.title: New mechanic: Ages!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/ecb2408ac799a2018e1945cdcc8c32e8f5494c8a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/ecb2408ac799a2018e1945cdcc8c32e8f5494c8a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/ecb2408ac799a2018e1945cdcc8c32e8f5494c8a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/ecb2408ac799a2018e1945cdcc8c32e8f5494c8a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/ecb2408ac799a2018e1945cdcc8c32e8f5494c8a.png[/img]

Hello there!

Other big feature of the upcoming update is new [b]Ages System[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/9ebb44dff1267d2a67e7418c13b7b99eb9bf5be6.png[/img]

In WorldBox, time moves quickly, so adding a day/night cycle or seasonal changes like winter and summer wouldn't make sense. Instead, we've been working on an [b]Ages System[/b] that will take your worlds through a series of years, each with its unique impact on the environment and civilizations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/ecb2408ac799a2018e1945cdcc8c32e8f5494c8a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/ecb2408ac799a2018e1945cdcc8c32e8f5494c8a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/ecb2408ac799a2018e1945cdcc8c32e8f5494c8a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/ecb2408ac799a2018e1945cdcc8c32e8f5494c8a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/ecb2408ac799a2018e1945cdcc8c32e8f5494c8a.png[/img]

Some Ages will bring harsh conditions and disasters, while others will introduce magic clouds and better environments for your people to thrive in. The mood of kings/leaders will be influenced, leading to more wars or peaceful periods, and population fertility rates and food growth will be affected!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/ecb2408ac799a2018e1945cdcc8c32e8f5494c8a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/ecb2408ac799a2018e1945cdcc8c32e8f5494c8a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/ecb2408ac799a2018e1945cdcc8c32e8f5494c8a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/ecb2408ac799a2018e1945cdcc8c32e8f5494c8a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/ecb2408ac799a2018e1945cdcc8c32e8f5494c8a.png[/img]

There will be 10 different Ages, each with a unique name and effects:
[b]
Age of Hope 
Age of Sun
Age of Dark
Age of Tears
Age of Moon
Age of Chaos
Age of Wonders
Age of Ice
Age of Ash
Age of Despair
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/a18b0384d72ddb03ffcaa2968929eb5df9234554.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/73238f56aa5d834b44147f53eb8741bc7773c485.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/2e2be57f0577f2c199e924a95fb11567be294939.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/22a52a80480f1f4fdd39c325308de57f7eb4dbbd.png[/img]

We won't reveal too much about each age just yet, but the names alone should give you an idea of what to expect!

We're currently beta testing the update with some players to ensure everything runs smoothly, and we've already fixed a lot of stuff!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/ecb2408ac799a2018e1945cdcc8c32e8f5494c8a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/ecb2408ac799a2018e1945cdcc8c32e8f5494c8a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/ecb2408ac799a2018e1945cdcc8c32e8f5494c8a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/ecb2408ac799a2018e1945cdcc8c32e8f5494c8a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/ecb2408ac799a2018e1945cdcc8c32e8f5494c8a.png[/img]

notes.title: Diplomacy is changing
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/ad83a06cf61f886cdd965a1f51542e359962e393.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/ad83a06cf61f886cdd965a1f51542e359962e393.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/ad83a06cf61f886cdd965a1f51542e359962e393.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/e7e46dccc45a3ad86cc0e2dbc4554768dc2690d8.png[/img]

One of the major new features of the upcoming update is a brand new diplomacy system, which we're calling "Plans and Plots". This mechanic brings everything together into one connected system, including clans, alliances, rebellions and wars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/55043d49784db7c0e68b9cfe04424f3f7ac24f03.png[/img]

Prior to this update, diplomacy was happening behind the scenes, with players only able to see the results of the decisions made by kings and leaders. However, with the new system, royal clan members will first create a plan before making any major moves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/633d63f9123ce5c51dae99003f56b8005f4c7d27.png[/img]

For instance, they might initiate a plan to start a war, form an alliance, or even spark a rebellion. These plans will take time to come to fruition, and players will be able to track their progress as they unfold.

And, of course, the fun part is that you will be able to handle it and direct your attention towards a king who intends to wage war against your favorite kingdom. (With life eraser, bombs, or Crabzilla lasers)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/58d29572faf37b308ffc85335d1a9d9d73979716.png[/img]

There are currently several different types of plots available, including starting a war, creating a treaty, forming/breaking an alliance and inciting rebellion. We have [i]plans(heh)[/i] to add even more plot types in the future, but those will come in later updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/5b53a2cffde350b1d37825368d9e33e80b607885.png[/img]

Bonus: New tower animations from Hugo!

notes.title: Expanded Wars Mechanic
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/6f1f575c397d0f7b9478152c1cc677d1bd736e41.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/6f1f575c397d0f7b9478152c1cc677d1bd736e41.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/6f1f575c397d0f7b9478152c1cc677d1bd736e41.png[/img]

The upcoming update will rework and improve the wars mechanic in WorldBox.

The previous friend/foe system will be replaced by a more sophisticated system, where each war will have a unique name and opposing sides. 

The war will come to an end when the main sides are defeated, or if the conflict is resolved through diplomatic means or player intervention

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/89dd655e8f50e3cc929b528f50bf593b89902864.png[/img]

With the new war system, players will also be able to see more information about the wars, including the number of casualties and its duration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/96fb48cfa110adf38dc02c6b2677bc0f8ef31f7b.png[/img]

On the minimap, players can see current wars displayed as lines connecting the opposing sides with icons indicating who is attacking whom.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/c6afe7ba6f5355c3982219d94b32e56ce247843a.png[/img]

The update features several war types, including one related to the Spite power. 

Using the Spite power over a kingdom will now initiate a global war with all other kingdoms on the map, and the war will continue until the targeted kingdom is the only one standing or has been defeated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/83a7d01e4b0732eb0a4f8dae3b3f206a5687f2a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/c792ca65f7b9c4e93efab8dc5eb691f99541153f.png[/img]

Additionally, the update introduces a new power, Whisper of War. With this ability, players can incite a kingdom to wage war against their desired target.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/cdba7c51841d7c6cff81ea0a58e32c286e989245.png[/img]

notes.title: Upcoming new mechanic: Clans and Bloodlines
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/8f071b4badcaba90d01410c8c55ebb9816d8385e.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/8f071b4badcaba90d01410c8c55ebb9816d8385e.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/8f071b4badcaba90d01410c8c55ebb9816d8385e.png[/img]

The upcoming update will introduce a new mechanic called [b]clans[/b]. [b]Clans[/b] are groups of individuals who share a common ancestor, and these bloodlines will play a significant role in the game simulation. 

The update will also change the way leaders and kings are chosen, as only members of a clan will be eligible for those positions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/777a5371d423ce10d7da0052fbbd9cb7ee390884.png[/img]

This new feature will greatly impact diplomacy and relationships between kingdoms. For example, clans that are closely related to the ruling clan will be more likely to form [b]alliances[/b], while those that are not may be more likely to engage in conflicts. 

Additionally, the loyalty of cities will also be affected as leaders from the same clan as the king will be more inclined to be loyal to their king.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/91a4e5fdf35e536466f608f4fa3826777d7c9ecd.png[/img]

Another addition to this system is a new map layer, which will allow players to see which clan currently rules and where, giving them a better understanding of the “political landscape” of the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/26bd4464834ad89e06c0a330045608a8b0ace384.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/8f071b4badcaba90d01410c8c55ebb9816d8385e.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39496096/8f071b4badcaba90d01410c8c55ebb9816d8385e.png[/img]

At this time, we do not have a confirmed release date for the upcoming update. The process of balancing the update with new mechanics is taking longer than anticipated, and we want to ensure that new features is thoroughly tested and polished before releasing it to the public. 

We understand that many players are eagerly awaiting the release of this update and we apologize for the delay. Rest assured, when we are more confident about the release date, we will make an official announcement to keep you informed. We appreciate your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Announcement about next updates from Team WorldBox
notes.notes:
Hey!

[b]Small announcement[/b]. We are working hard on the next update and multiple separate features(don’t ask mastef about it), which will be a pretty big one. Stay tuned and expect some sneak peeks soon!

Sometimes people ask why content updates take so long. As the game evolves and more features are added - some of the old code becomes hard to deal with and needs to be adapted. It requires big changes under the hood.

If you played the game like a factorio - it’s a bit like rewiring 50% of your factories and conveyor belts, while keeping half of them not touched and working. It’s a subtle job, which could bring non-obvious new bugs, which also take time to fix. Like cats attacking mages in cold blood.

As a result, this rewiring work would make next updates easier to make and maintain.

It also makes the life of the modders much easier. And modding support we hope to improve a lot after steam release and workshop integration.

In the last year we reworked some of these parts of the code. And now working on another big chunk of these improvements

Cheers!

Team WorldBox
